mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair tadalafil clearance and increase cardiovascular risk, while both drugs can cause hypotension.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider dose reduction of tadalafil or alternative PDE5 inhibitor if amphotericin B use is necessary.
